meta.title: Ignacio Lizana – Senior Full-Stack Engineer
meta.description: Ignacio Lizana – Senior Full-Stack Engineer (React, TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Supabase). 7+ years building fintech, SaaS and AI products. Based in Valencia, Spain.

hero.description1: Senior Full-Stack Engineer with 7+ years shipping production platforms end to end
hero.description4: Strong in React, TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL and Supabase.

entries.description: Top Rated on Upwork (100% Job Success, 5.0★). Production builds, audits and fixes for SaaS clients on Next.js, Supabase and Stripe. Built an interactive kiosk for a live art exhibition and shipped ~300 UI fixes and admin improvements on a booking marketplace.

Engineered and deployed a multi-brand SaaS via a zero-downtime Next.js/Supabase migration, integrating parallel-write PostgreSQL, end-to-end Stripe payments, strict RLS, and 30+ Make.com API workflows.

Led technical execution across multiple client-facing streaming platforms in a B2B OTT environment, bridging product, business and engineering teams. Led the new corporate website and product landings (React, TypeScript, Strapi CMS), coordinated frontend tasks and code reviews aligned with Figma, and supported backend debugging to stabilize production streaming environments.

Delivered the first production version of a crypto investment platform in under 6 months, reaching 100+ early adopters and $1.1M+ USD in managed investments. Defined the technical roadmap and architecture (Remix/React Router, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Docker, Google Cloud), cut deployment time to under 5 minutes and increased mobile session time by 27%. Secured acceptance into the Lanzadera accelerator.

Designed and launched a mobile app and real-time control panel for municipal safety inspectors, adopted by 150+ field agents in the first month and reducing emergency response time by 33%. Led architecture and backend integration (TypeScript, Remix/React Router, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Docker, Google Cloud).
Built enterprise applications in .NET Core and React that scaled to 100+ daily users. Migrated legacy systems to a component-based architecture, reducing maintenance time from weeks to days.

Led the frontend in React and Tailwind for an ML-based price recommendation system. Created dashboards for market trends and sales. The project was awarded Best AI and Data Science Project at the USM Software Fair.

entries.title: Educ.IA – AI Enrolment Platform on Web & WhatsApp (Side Project)
entries.description: Conversational AI platform for training centers: AI agents on web and WhatsApp for 24/7 student support and lead capture, a RAG knowledge base, and OCR document validation with Google Cloud Vision. Selected for the Lanzadera accelerator.

entries.title: Interactive Kiosk for a Live Art Exhibition + Web3 Identity Dashboard
entries.description: Built an on-site interactive kiosk used live during an art exhibition, plus the web platform where users claim unique codenames and track their digital assets. Implemented an animated, Figma-accurate UI with React Router, TypeScript and Supabase.

entries.title: Booking Marketplace – Frontend & Backend Fixes
entries.description: Improved a production booking marketplace and its admin dashboard: fixed critical backend bugs, built new pages and features (CMS banner, redesigned product cards, real-time data), and shipped ~300 responsive UI fixes across mobile, tablet and desktop.

entries.title: Video, Audio, and Subtitle Overlay Editing App
entries.description: An interactive editing app that lets you transform a simple talking-head video into an engaging Instagram Reel or TikTok clip. By highlighting specific subtitle segments, you can seamlessly add corresponding video clips and/or audio overlays to those moments, all managed through a sleek, modern React web interface.

entries.title: Modern Fintech Landing Page
entries.description: High-impact crypto-investment landing page that communicates trust, simplicity, and performance. This project was built as a fully responsive marketing site for Block Capital. The challenge was to merge a premium financial feel with startup-style modern design.

entries.title: Handy God - 2D game in Unity
entries.description: A 2D platformer with physics developed in Unity where the player controls both a stickman (with WASD + Space to move and jump) and a floating hand (with the mouse). The hand can move or dismantle objects to clear obstacles or create paths, while the stickman advances through the level.

about.title: About me
about.description: My story and experience as a developer

content.paragraph1: I'm Ignacio, Chilean 🇨🇱 a Computer Science Engineer (BSc) from the Santa María University. Most of what I've learned in tech has been self-taught, always finding a way to solve problems and create solutions.
content.paragraph2: I was the CTO of Block Capital, a fintech startup that I helped build from scratch into a full-stack product. That experience brought me to Valencia, Spain 🇪🇸 after being selected by Lanzadera, one of Europe's top accelerators.
content.paragraph3: My path hasn't been linear: I went from learning on my own in Chile to leading projects and people in Europe. That mix of being self-taught and an entrepreneur defines my way of working: always looking for solutions, with the conviction that every challenge is an opportunity for growth.
